description:
A model student from M.M.R. Vocational School, who is both honest and composed.
Having no dreams or aspirations of her own, she is merely doing what she believes is the correct thing to do.
She appears very calm, and is always looking after Rei and Ein in subtle ways.

lines.text:
The secret to maintaining good grades?
Hmm... just go over the textbooks and prepare, I guess?
Now that I'm a sophomore, I should work harder to be a role model for the freshmen.

Have you seen the new field manual they published recently?
I flipped through it to get a sneak preview of what's to come, and there's so much to learn!

I'm not really hoping for anything in particular...
I just want Rei, Ein, and me to all graduate safely and smoothly together.

Ein is always talking about looking cool.
Do you think I'll look cool if I undo a few buttons on my uniform?

I often jot down whatever thoughts come to my mind in my notebook.
That way, I won't forget.
Should I review what I learned today once I return to the dorm?

I'll stay here and study until you get back.
When you do, can we resume our counseling session?
What kind of lessons are taught at the Tactics Academy?

Ein accidentally played Volume's new song and got us all kicked out.
I suppose it was unintentional...

Ms. Privaty is at the Courthouse, right? 
Sorry? She's at the Maid Cafe? But why...?

I'm Zwei, a sophomore at M.M.R. Vocational School.
I look forward to working with you this semester.
Reloading mechanism upgraded.
Studying hard does have its perks.
I can't rest on my laurels. I need to keep pushing myself further.
A gift? For me? What is it?
Thank you, Teacher.
Can I share this with Rei and Ein?
I'll keep at it until the day when I can call you Commander.
Will you come to teach us again, Teacher?
Teacher, is it okay if I act a bit childish every once in a while?
I always feel nervous during real battles. Watch my back, okay?
You called?
Let's move to the right.
Make sure that everyone is fully prepared.
Proceeding as usual.
Deploying formation.
Leave the battle to me.
Activating reloading mechanism.
Let me run some calculations...
I'll be with you soon.
Ready to fire.
I hope you'll enjoy the fruits of my efforts.
Coordinates calculated. Focusing firepower!
One target down.
Where's the next target?
Easy.
Ow!
Eeep!
It hurts...
What did I do wrong? I did exactly what I was taught...
All clear. I'm glad this battle ended safely.

favorite.name: Four-Leaf Clover Bookmark
favorite.description: A bookmark adorned with a symbol of good fortune. For someone whose life felt uncertain or frightening, it must have given them the courage to keep going.
